note: universe_core widened with the five funds that were measurably different from what it already held, out of twelve fetched. The test applied was correlation against every asset already in the book over 2016-2026: a candidate whose closest match was above roughly 0.7 is the same bet under another name and was left out.
asset_class_note: KOSEF 미국달러선물 moved from a currency class of its own into USD_RATES beside TIGER 미국채10년선물. The two correlate 0.754 because an unhedged US Treasury fund is a dollar bet before it is a rates bet, and giving each its own class would put a third of the book on the dollar while believing it put a sixth.

rejected.308620 KODEX 미국채10년선물: the same US 10-year bet as the kept 305080, with less history
rejected.144600 KODEX 은선물: 0.755 with the gold fund already held
rejected.329200 TIGER 리츠부동산인프라: 0.540 with KOSPI 200, and no history before mid-2019
rejected.114800 KODEX 인버스: -0.995 with KOSPI 200, which is the best diversification number in the whole search and still a reason to refuse it. A daily-reset inverse fund lost 71.2% over this decade; an allocation rule holding it permanently is paying that bleed forever in exchange for a hedge it could get by holding less equity. Negative correlation is not free when the asset has negative expected return.

survivorship_warning: Every ETF here still trades. Funds that were wound up are absent, so results are an upper bound.
cost_warning: Prices come from KIS and are market prices: each fund's own fee is already deducted from them, so --expense-ratio must not be used to model it again. What is missing is the other direction — KIS prices are not adjusted for distributions, so every return here is understated by roughly the fund's yield, which is a point or two a year for equity ETFs and most of the return for the bond ones.
history_warning: TIGER 미국채10년선물 lists in August 2018, so the first two and a half years of a 2016 run have no US Treasury sleeve and USD_RATES is carried by the currency fund alone. The engine knows the fund is unavailable and will not weight it, but the early years are a different portfolio from the later ones.
equity_classes_note: Which asset classes count as the equity sleeve, so a tool can set the equity share explicitly instead of expressing it by redrawing the class lines. Over ten taxonomies the strategy's Sharpe ran 0.71-1.11 and that spread correlated 0.89 with the non-equity share alone.
